name: Sumitomo Metal Mining Co., Ltd.
summary: Sumitomo Metal Mining Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the resource development, manufacture, and sale of non-ferrous metal products in Japan and internationally. It operates through Mineral Resources, Smelting and Refining, and Material segments.
